symbols.name: real number
symbols.meaning: The real number that the ceiling rounds up to an integer.

symbols.name: integer
symbols.meaning: Any integer, which is its own ceiling.
symbols.quote: The symbol $j$ stands for any integer, and an integer is its own ceiling: $\lceil j \rceil = j$.

relations.quote: The ceiling rounds up recovered coefficients on the way to the binary product of [exact integer multiplication](exact-integer-multiplication.md).
